name: phone-monitor
description: Phone Monitor: an Electron desktop app + Android agent that live-mirror and remotely control (AnyDesk-style) many Android phones — near or far, real-time, private.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w helper
scripts.prepare:desktop: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w helper && npm run prepare-assets -w desktop
scripts.start:desktop: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run prepare:desktop && npm run dist -w desktop
